km.eligibility: និស្សិតបរិញ្ញាបត្រថ្មីរបស់ SIM មកពីព្រុយណេ មីយ៉ាន់ម៉ា កម្ពុជា ឥណ្ឌូនេស៊ី ឡាវ ម៉ាឡេស៊ី ហ្វីលីពីន ថៃ ឬវៀតណាម ដែលបានចុះឈ្មោះ និងចាប់ផ្តើមរៀន មានលទ្ធផលវិទ្យាល័យ/ប្រឡងជាតិល្អ និងមានភាពជាអ្នកដឹកនាំ។
km.english_test: តាមលក្ខខណ្ឌចូលរៀនបរិញ្ញាបត្ររបស់ SIM
km.intake: និស្សិតបរិញ្ញាបត្រថ្មី SIM ឆ្នាំ 2027
km.notes: មិនចាំបាច់ដាក់ពាក្យអាហារូបករណ៍៖ ជ្រើសរើសតាមលទ្ធផលសិក្សា បេក្ខជនដែលជាប់នឹងត្រូវអញ្ជើញសម្ភាសន៍។ ដាក់ពាក្យបរិញ្ញាបត្រ SIM តាមរយៈទីប្រឹក្សា Talented។

fr.name: SIM ASEAN Impact Award
fr.fields: Programmes de licence (undergraduate) à SIM
fr.coverage: Aide financière de S$3 000 pour les nouveaux étudiants de licence des pays de l’ASEAN (hors Singapour)
fr.eligibility: Nouveaux étudiants de licence à SIM venant de Brunei, Myanmar, Cambodge, Indonésie, Laos, Malaisie, Philippines, Thaïlande ou Vietnam ; inscrits et ayant commencé les cours ; bons résultats au lycée/examen national ; qualités/expérience de leadership.
fr.english_test: Selon les conditions d’admission en licence de SIM
fr.notes: Aucune candidature requise : sélection sur le mérite académique, les candidats présélectionnés sont invités à un entretien. Candidature au programme SIM via votre conseiller Talented.

pt.name: SIM ASEAN Impact Award
pt.fields: Programas de graduação na SIM
pt.coverage: Auxílio financeiro de S$3.000 para novos alunos de graduação de países da ASEAN (exceto Singapura)
pt.eligibility: Novos alunos de graduação da SIM de Brunei, Mianmar, Camboja, Indonésia, Laos, Malásia, Filipinas, Tailândia ou Vietnã; matriculados e com aulas iniciadas; bons resultados no ensino médio/exame nacional; qualidades/experiência de liderança.
pt.english_test: Conforme os requisitos de admissão da graduação da SIM
pt.notes: Não é preciso se candidatar à bolsa: seleção por mérito acadêmico e pré-selecionados são convidados para entrevista. Candidate-se à graduação SIM pelo consultor Talented.

es.name: SIM ASEAN Impact Award
es.fields: Programas de grado en SIM
es.coverage: Ayuda económica de S$3.000 para nuevos estudiantes de grado de países de la ASEAN (excepto Singapur)
es.eligibility: Nuevos estudiantes de grado de SIM de Brunéi, Myanmar, Camboya, Indonesia, Laos, Malasia, Filipinas, Tailandia o Vietnam; matriculados y con clases iniciadas; buenos resultados de secundaria/examen nacional; cualidades/experiencia de liderazgo.
es.english_test: Según los requisitos de admisión de grado de SIM
es.notes: No hace falta solicitar la beca: la selección es por mérito académico y los preseleccionados son invitados a una entrevista. Solicita el grado SIM con tu consultor Talented.

de.name: SIM ASEAN Impact Award
de.fields: Bachelorprogramme an der SIM
de.coverage: Finanzielle Unterstützung von S$3.000 für neue Bachelorstudierende aus ASEAN-Ländern (außer Singapur)
de.eligibility: Neue Bachelorstudierende der SIM aus Brunei, Myanmar, Kambodscha, Indonesien, Laos, Malaysia, den Philippinen, Thailand oder Vietnam; eingeschrieben und Studienbeginn erfolgt; gute Schul-/Abschlussprüfungsnoten; Führungsqualitäten/-erfahrung.
de.english_test: Gemäß den Zulassungsvoraussetzungen der SIM für Bachelorprogramme
de.notes: Keine Stipendienbewerbung nötig: Auswahl nach akademischer Leistung, Kandidaten der engeren Wahl werden zum Gespräch eingeladen. Bewerbung für das SIM-Studium über Ihre Talented-Beratung.

it.name: SIM ASEAN Impact Award
it.fields: Corsi di laurea triennale presso SIM
it.coverage: Contributo di S$3.000 per nuovi studenti di laurea dei paesi ASEAN (esclusa Singapore)
it.eligibility: Nuovi studenti di laurea SIM provenienti da Brunei, Myanmar, Cambogia, Indonesia, Laos, Malesia, Filippine, Thailandia o Vietnam; iscritti e con lezioni iniziate; buoni risultati scolastici/esame nazionale; doti/esperienza di leadership.
it.english_test: Secondo i requisiti di ammissione ai corsi di laurea SIM
it.notes: Nessuna domanda di borsa richiesta: selezione per merito accademico, i candidati preselezionati sono invitati a un colloquio. Iscriviti a SIM tramite il tuo consulente Talented.

nl.name: SIM ASEAN Impact Award
nl.fields: Bacheloropleidingen bij SIM
nl.coverage: Financiële steun van S$3.000 voor nieuwe bachelorstudenten uit ASEAN-landen (behalve Singapore)
nl.eligibility: Nieuwe bachelorstudenten van SIM uit Brunei, Myanmar, Cambodja, Indonesië, Laos, Maleisië, de Filipijnen, Thailand of Vietnam; ingeschreven en met de lessen begonnen; goede middelbare school-/eindexamenresultaten; leiderschapskwaliteiten/-ervaring.
nl.english_test: Volgens de toelatingseisen voor bacheloropleidingen van SIM
nl.notes: Geen beursaanvraag nodig: selectie op academische prestaties, geselecteerde kandidaten worden uitgenodigd voor een gesprek. Meld je aan voor SIM via je Talented-consulent.

ru.name: SIM ASEAN Impact Award
ru.fields: Программы бакалавриата в SIM
ru.coverage: Финансовая помощь S$3 000 новым студентам бакалавриата из стран АСЕАН (кроме Сингапура)
ru.eligibility: Новые студенты бакалавриата SIM из Брунея, Мьянмы, Камбоджи, Индонезии, Лаоса, Малайзии, Филиппин, Таиланда или Вьетнама; зачислены и начали занятия; хорошие школьные/национальные экзаменационные оценки; лидерские качества/опыт.
ru.notes: Заявка на стипендию не нужна: отбор по успеваемости, кандидаты из шорт-листа приглашаются на собеседование. Поступление в SIM через консультанта Talented.

km.english_test: IELTS overall 6.5 (no band <6.0)

th.coverage: ค่าเล่าเรียนเต็มจำนวนตลอดระยะทุน + ค่าครองชีพ RM1,500/เดือน
th.amount: RM1,500/เดือน + ค่าเล่าเรียน
th.eligibility: พลเมืองอินโดนีเซีย (ประเทศอาเซียนผู้รับทุน); ปริญญาโทอายุไม่เกิน 40 ปี GPA ป.ตรี 3.00 ขึ้นไป; ปริญญาเอกอายุไม่เกิน 45 ปี; เรียนเต็มเวลาในมหาวิทยาลัยมาเลเซีย
th.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550 (หรือปริญญาเดิมที่สอนเป็นภาษาอังกฤษ)
th.notes: รอบสมัคร 2026/2027 ปิดแล้ว ยังไม่ประกาศรอบถัดไป สมัครออนไลน์ที่ biasiswa.mohe.gov.my

vi.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
vi.fields: Mọi chương trình được kiểm định (ưu tiên giáo dục, khoa học xã hội, kinh doanh, khoa học, ICT, kỹ thuật, nông nghiệp, y tế trừ y khoa/điều dưỡng/dược)
vi.coverage: Toàn bộ học phí trong thời gian tài trợ + sinh hoạt phí RM1.500/tháng
vi.eligibility: Công dân Indonesia (nước ASEAN được nhận); Thạc sĩ tối đa 40 tuổi & GPA cử nhân từ 3,00; Tiến sĩ tối đa 45 tuổi; học toàn thời gian tại đại học Malaysia.
vi.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550 (hoặc bằng trước học bằng tiếng Anh)
vi.notes: Đợt nộp 2026/2027 đã đóng; lịch tiếp theo chưa công bố. Nộp trực tuyến tại biasiswa.mohe.gov.my.

zh.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
zh.fields: 所有认证课程（优先：教育、社科、商科、理科、ICT、工程、农业、健康类，医学/护理/药学除外）
zh.coverage: 资助期内全额学费 + 每月 RM1,500 生活津贴
zh.eligibility: 印尼公民（东盟受惠国）；硕士不超过 40 岁且本科 GPA≥3.00；博士不超过 45 岁；在马来西亚大学全日制就读。
zh.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550（或此前学位以英语授课）
zh.notes: 2026/2027 申请已截止，下一轮尚未公布。在 biasiswa.mohe.gov.my 在线申请。

ja.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
ja.fields: 認定された全プログラム（優先：教育、社会科学、ビジネス、理学、ICT、工学、農業、医療系〈医学・看護・薬学を除く〉）
ja.coverage: 支援期間中の授業料全額 + 生活費 月 RM1,500
ja.eligibility: インドネシア国籍（ASEAN 対象国）。修士は 40 歳以下・学士 GPA 3.00 以上、博士は 45 歳以下。マレーシアの大学でフルタイム就学。
ja.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550（または英語で取得した前学位）
ja.notes: 2026/2027 の募集は終了。次回日程は未発表。biasiswa.mohe.gov.my でオンライン申請。

ko.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
ko.fields: 모든 인증 과정(우선: 교육, 사회과학, 경영, 자연과학, ICT, 공학, 농업, 보건—의학/간호/약학 제외)
ko.coverage: 지원 기간 등록금 전액 + 생활비 월 RM1,500
ko.eligibility: 인도네시아 국민(아세안 수혜국); 석사 만 40세 이하·학사 GPA 3.00 이상; 박사 만 45세 이하; 말레이시아 대학 전일제 재학.
ko.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550(또는 영어로 이수한 이전 학위)
ko.notes: 2026/2027 모집은 마감, 다음 일정 미발표. biasiswa.mohe.gov.my에서 온라인 지원.

km.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
km.fields: កម្មវិធីទទួលស្គាល់ទាំងអស់ (អាទិភាព៖ អប់រំ សង្គមសាស្ត្រ ពាណិជ្ជកម្ម វិទ្យាសាស្ត្រ ICT វិស្វកម្ម កសិកម្ម សុខាភិបាល លើកលែងវេជ្ជសាស្ត្រ/គិលានុបដ្ឋាក/ឱសថ)
km.coverage: ថ្លៃសិក្សាពេញក្នុងរយៈពេលឧបត្ថម្ភ + ប្រាក់រស់នៅ RM1,500/ខែ
km.eligibility: ពលរដ្ឋឥណ្ឌូនេស៊ី (ប្រទេសអាស៊ានទទួល); អនុបណ្ឌិតអាយុមិនលើស 40 ឆ្នាំ GPA បរិញ្ញាបត្រ 3.00; បណ្ឌិតអាយុមិនលើស 45 ឆ្នាំ; សិក្សាពេញម៉ោងនៅសាកលវិទ្យាល័យម៉ាឡេស៊ី។
km.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550 (ឬសញ្ញាបត្រមុនបង្រៀនជាភាសាអង់គ្លេស)
km.notes: វគ្គដាក់ពាក្យ 2026/2027 បានបិទ កាលវិភាគបន្ទាប់មិនទាន់ប្រកាស។ ដាក់ពាក្យតាមអនឡាញនៅ biasiswa.mohe.gov.my។

fr.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
fr.fields: Tous programmes accrédités (priorité : éducation, sciences sociales, commerce, sciences, TIC, ingénierie, agriculture, santé hors médecine/soins infirmiers/pharmacie)
fr.coverage: Frais de scolarité complets pendant la bourse + allocation de RM1 500/mois
fr.eligibility: Citoyens indonésiens (pays ASEAN bénéficiaire) ; Master âge max. 40 ans et GPA licence min. 3,00 ; Doctorat âge max. 45 ans ; études à temps plein dans une université malaisienne.
fr.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550 (ou diplôme antérieur enseigné en anglais)
fr.notes: La session 2026/2027 est close ; prochain calendrier non annoncé. Candidature en ligne sur biasiswa.mohe.gov.my.

pt.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
pt.fields: Todos os programas credenciados (prioridade: educação, ciências sociais, negócios, ciências, TIC, engenharia, agricultura, saúde exceto medicina/enfermagem/farmácia)
pt.coverage: Mensalidade integral no período da bolsa + auxílio de RM1.500/mês
pt.eligibility: Cidadãos indonésios (país ASEAN contemplado); Mestrado idade máx. 40 e GPA da graduação mín. 3,00; Doutorado idade máx. 45; estudo em tempo integral em universidade da Malásia.
pt.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550 (ou diploma anterior em inglês)
pt.notes: O período 2026/2027 foi encerrado; próximo calendário ainda não divulgado. Inscrição online em biasiswa.mohe.gov.my.

es.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
es.fields: Todos los programas acreditados (prioridad: educación, ciencias sociales, negocios, ciencias, TIC, ingeniería, agricultura, salud excepto medicina/enfermería/farmacia)
es.coverage: Matrícula completa durante la beca + ayuda de RM1.500/mes
es.eligibility: Ciudadanos indonesios (país ASEAN beneficiario); Máster edad máx. 40 y GPA de grado mín. 3,00; Doctorado edad máx. 45; estudio a tiempo completo en una universidad de Malasia.
es.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550 (o título anterior impartido en inglés)
es.notes: La convocatoria 2026/2027 está cerrada; el próximo calendario no se ha anunciado. Solicitud en línea en biasiswa.mohe.gov.my.

de.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
de.fields: Alle akkreditierten Programme (Priorität: Bildung, Sozialwissenschaften, Wirtschaft, Naturwissenschaften, IKT, Ingenieurwesen, Landwirtschaft, Gesundheit außer Medizin/Pflege/Pharmazie)
de.coverage: Volle Studiengebühren im Förderzeitraum + Lebenshaltung RM1.500/Monat
de.eligibility: Indonesische Staatsangehörige (ASEAN-Empfängerland); Master max. 40 Jahre & Bachelor-GPA min. 3,00; PhD max. 45 Jahre; Vollzeitstudium an einer malaysischen Universität.
de.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550 (oder früherer englischsprachiger Abschluss)
de.notes: Bewerbungsrunde 2026/2027 ist geschlossen; nächster Termin noch nicht bekannt. Online-Bewerbung über biasiswa.mohe.gov.my.

it.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
it.fields: Tutti i programmi accreditati (priorità: istruzione, scienze sociali, business, scienze, ICT, ingegneria, agricoltura, salute esclusi medicina/infermieristica/farmacia)
it.coverage: Tasse universitarie complete per il periodo della borsa + RM1.500/mese per il mantenimento
it.eligibility: Cittadini indonesiani (paese ASEAN beneficiario); Master età max. 40 e GPA triennale min. 3,00; Dottorato età max. 45; studio a tempo pieno in un’università malese.
it.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550 (o titolo precedente in inglese)
it.notes: La sessione 2026/2027 è chiusa; prossimo calendario non ancora annunciato. Candidatura online su biasiswa.mohe.gov.my.

nl.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
nl.fields: Alle geaccrediteerde opleidingen (voorrang: onderwijs, sociale wetenschappen, business, wetenschappen, ICT, techniek, landbouw, zorg behalve geneeskunde/verpleegkunde/farmacie)
nl.coverage: Volledig collegegeld tijdens de beurs + RM1.500/maand leefgeld
nl.eligibility: Indonesische staatsburgers (ASEAN-ontvangend land); master max. 40 jaar & bachelor-GPA min. 3,00; PhD max. 45 jaar; voltijds studeren aan een Maleisische universiteit.
nl.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550 (of eerdere Engelstalige graad)
nl.notes: De ronde 2026/2027 is gesloten; volgende planning nog niet bekend. Online aanmelden via biasiswa.mohe.gov.my.

ru.name: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
ru.fields: Все аккредитованные программы (приоритет: образование, соцнауки, бизнес, естественные науки, ИКТ, инженерия, сельское хозяйство, здравоохранение кроме медицины/сестринского дела/фармации)
ru.coverage: Полная оплата обучения на срок стипендии + RM1 500/мес. на проживание
ru.eligibility: Граждане Индонезии (страна АСЕАН); магистратура — до 40 лет и GPA бакалавра от 3,00; PhD — до 45 лет; очное обучение в университете Малайзии.
ru.english_test: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL PBT 550 (или предыдущий диплом на английском)
ru.notes: Набор 2026/2027 закрыт; следующий график не объявлен. Подача онлайн на biasiswa.mohe.gov.my.

items.name: RMIT Vietnam International Excellence Scholarships 2027
items.fields: Program sarjana RMIT Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Danang)
items.coverage: Potongan 50% atau 25% tuition untuk seluruh program (2027: 6 x 50% dan 6 x 25%)
items.eligibility: Bukan warga negara Vietnam (WNI bisa); sudah apply program sarjana & memenuhi syarat masuk; nilai rata-rata kelas akhir SMA min. 80%; bukan mahasiswa S1 RMIT Vietnam.
items.english_test: Sesuai syarat masuk program sarjana RMIT Vietnam
items.notes: Batas: Sem 1 18 Jan 2027, Sem 2 3 Mei 2027, Sem 3 20 Agu 2027 (17.00 WIB). Sangat kompetitif, diurutkan dari nilai SMA. Daftar lewat konsultan Talented.

en.name: RMIT Vietnam International Excellence Scholarships 2027
en.fields: RMIT Vietnam undergraduate programmes (Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Danang)
en.coverage: 50% or 25% tuition reduction for the whole programme (2027: 6 x 50% and 6 x 25%)
en.eligibility: Non-Vietnamese citizens (Indonesians eligible); applied to an undergraduate programme and meet entry requirements; final-year high school average min. 80%; not a current RMIT Vietnam undergraduate.
en.english_test: As per RMIT Vietnam undergraduate entry requirements
en.notes: Deadlines: Sem 1 18 Jan 2027, Sem 2 3 May 2027, Sem 3 20 Aug 2027 (5pm GMT+7). Highly competitive, ranked by high school results. Apply through your Talented consultant.

th.name: RMIT Vietnam International Excellence Scholarships 2027
th.fields: หลักสูตรปริญญาตรี RMIT Vietnam (โฮจิมินห์ ฮานอย ดานัง)
th.coverage: ลดค่าเล่าเรียน 50% หรือ 25% ตลอดหลักสูตร (2027: 6 ทุน 50% และ 6 ทุน 25%)
th.amount: 25% / 50% ค่าเล่าเรียน
th.eligibility: ไม่ใช่พลเมืองเวียดนาม (ชาวอินโดนีเซียสมัครได้) สมัครหลักสูตรปริญญาตรีและผ่านเกณฑ์รับเข้า เกรดเฉลี่ยมัธยมปีสุดท้ายอย่างน้อย 80% และไม่ใช่นักศึกษาปริญญาตรีปัจจุบันของ RMIT Vietnam
th.english_test: ตามเกณฑ์รับเข้าปริญญาตรีของ RMIT Vietnam
th.intake: ภาคเรียนที่ 1, 2, 3 ปี 2027
th.notes: กำหนดปิด: ภาค 1 18 ม.ค. 2027 ภาค 2 3 พ.ค. 2027 ภาค 3 20 ส.ค. 2027 (17.00 น. GMT+7) แข่งขันสูง จัดอันดับจากผลการเรียนมัธยม สมัครผ่านที่ปรึกษา Talented

vi.name: RMIT Vietnam International Excellence Scholarships 2027
vi.fields: Chương trình cử nhân RMIT Việt Nam (TP.HCM, Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng)
vi.coverage: Giảm 50% hoặc 25% học phí toàn khóa (2027: 6 suất 50% và 6 suất 25%)
vi.eligibility: Không phải công dân Việt Nam (người Indonesia đủ điều kiện); đã nộp hồ sơ cử nhân và đạt yêu cầu đầu vào; điểm trung bình lớp cuối THPT từ 80%; không phải sinh viên cử nhân hiện tại của RMIT Việt Nam.
vi.english_test: Theo yêu cầu đầu vào cử nhân RMIT Việt Nam
vi.notes: Hạn chót: HK1 18/1/2027, HK2 3/5/2027, HK3 20/8/2027 (17h GMT+7). Cạnh tranh cao, xếp hạng theo kết quả THPT. Đăng ký qua tư vấn viên Talented.

zh.name: RMIT Vietnam International Excellence Scholarships 2027
zh.fields: RMIT 越南本科课程（胡志明市、河内、岘港）
zh.eligibility: 非越南公民（印尼学生可申请）；已申请本科并符合入学要求；高中最后一年平均成绩≥80%；非 RMIT 越南在读本科生。
zh.english_test: 按 RMIT 越南本科入学要求
zh.notes: 截止：第 1 学期 2027-01-18，第 2 学期 2027-05-03，第 3 学期 2027-08-20（GMT+7 17:00）。竞争激烈，按高中成绩排名。请通过 Talented 顾问申请。

ja.name: RMIT Vietnam International Excellence Scholarships 2027
ja.fields: RMIT ベトナムの学士課程（ホーチミン、ハノイ、ダナン）
ja.coverage: 全課程の授業料 50% または 25% 減額（2027 年：50% 6 名、25% 6 名）
ja.eligibility: ベトナム国籍以外（インドネシア人可）。学士課程に出願し入学要件を満たすこと。高校最終学年の平均 80% 以上。RMIT ベトナムの在学生でないこと。
ja.english_test: RMIT ベトナム学士課程の入学要件に準拠
ja.notes: 締切：第1学期 2027/1/18、第2学期 2027/5/3、第3学期 2027/8/20（GMT+7 17:00）。競争率が高く高校成績順に選考。Talented のコンサルタント経由で申請。

ko.name: RMIT Vietnam International Excellence Scholarships 2027
ko.fields: RMIT 베트남 학사 과정(호치민, 하노이, 다낭)
ko.eligibility: 베트남 국적이 아닌 학생(인도네시아인 가능); 학사 과정 지원 및 입학 요건 충족; 고교 최종 학년 평균 80% 이상; RMIT 베트남 재학생 아님.
ko.english_test: RMIT 베트남 학사 입학 요건에 따름
ko.notes: 마감: 1학기 2027-01-18, 2학기 2027-05-03, 3학기 2027-08-20(GMT+7 17시). 경쟁이 치열하며 고교 성적순 선발. Talented 컨설턴트를 통해 지원하세요.

km.name: RMIT Vietnam International Excellence Scholarships 2027
km.fields: កម្មវិធីបរិញ្ញាបត្រ RMIT វៀតណាម (ហូជីមិញ ហាណូយ ដាណាំង)
km.coverage: បញ្ចុះថ្លៃសិក្សា 50% ឬ 25% សម្រាប់កម្មវិធីទាំងមូល (2027៖ 6 x 50% និង 6 x 25%)
km.eligibility: មិនមែនពលរដ្ឋវៀតណាម (ឥណ្ឌូនេស៊ីអាចដាក់បាន); បានដាក់ពាក្យបរិញ្ញាបត្រ និងបំពេញលក្ខខណ្ឌ; មធ្យមភាគថ្នាក់ចុងក្រោយវិទ្យាល័យយ៉ាងតិច 80%; មិនមែននិស្សិតបរិញ្ញាបត្របច្ចុប្បន្នរបស់ RMIT វៀតណាម។
km.english_test: តាមលក្ខខណ្ឌចូលរៀនបរិញ្ញាបត្រ RMIT វៀតណាម
km.notes: ផុតកំណត់៖ ឆមាស 1 18 មករា 2027, ឆមាស 2 3 ឧសភា 2027, ឆមាស 3 20 សីហា 2027 (17:00 GMT+7)។ ប្រកួតប្រជែងខ្លាំង ចាត់ថ្នាក់តាមលទ្ធផលវិទ្យាល័យ។ ដាក់ពាក្យតាមទីប្រឹក្សា Talented។

fr.name: RMIT Vietnam International Excellence Scholarships 2027
fr.fields: Programmes de licence de RMIT Vietnam (Hô Chi Minh-Ville, Hanoï, Da Nang)
fr.coverage: Réduction de 50 % ou 25 % des frais pour tout le programme (2027 : 6 x 50 % et 6 x 25 %)
fr.eligibility: Non-ressortissants vietnamiens (Indonésiens éligibles) ; candidature en licence et conditions d’admission remplies ; moyenne de terminale min. 80 % ; pas déjà étudiant de licence à RMIT Vietnam.
fr.english_test: Selon les conditions d’admission en licence de RMIT Vietnam
fr.notes: Dates limites : S1 18 janv. 2027, S2 3 mai 2027, S3 20 août 2027 (17 h GMT+7). Très sélectif, classement selon les notes du lycée. Candidature via votre conseiller Talented.

pt.name: RMIT Vietnam International Excellence Scholarships 2027

km.eligibility: និស្សិតអន្តរជាតិមកពីប្រទេសដែលបានកំណត់; ដាក់ពាក្យតាមវិបផតថល A2A ជ្រើសរើសដោយស្ថានទូតឥណ្ឌា។
km.english_test: តាមលក្ខខណ្ឌសាកលវិទ្យាល័យឥណ្ឌា
km.intake: កក្កដា/សីហា
km.notes: កាលវិភាគ 2026-27៖ វិបផតថល A2A បើក 7 កុម្ភៈ - 15 មេសា 2026។ កាលវិភាគ 2027-28 មិនទាន់ប្រកាស ជាធម្មតាបើកប្រហែលខែកុម្ភៈ។ សូមបញ្ជាក់កូតាឥណ្ឌូនេស៊ីជាមួយស្ថានទូតឥណ្ឌានៅហ្សាការតា។

fr.name: ICCR Scholarship (Government of India)
fr.fields: Licence, master et doctorat dans des universités indiennes
fr.coverage: Bourse du gouvernement indien (détail des allocations sur le portail A2A de l’ICCR)
fr.eligibility: Étudiants internationaux de pays désignés ; candidature via le portail A2A, sélection par l’ambassade d’Inde.
fr.english_test: Selon les exigences de l’université indienne
fr.notes: Calendrier 2026-27 : portail A2A ouvert du 7 févr. au 15 avr. 2026. Calendrier 2027-28 non annoncé ; ouverture habituelle vers février. Confirmez le quota indonésien auprès de l’ambassade d’Inde à Jakarta.

pt.name: ICCR Scholarship (Government of India)
pt.fields: Graduação, mestrado e doutorado em universidades indianas
pt.coverage: Bolsa do governo da Índia (detalhes dos auxílios no portal A2A da ICCR)
pt.eligibility: Estudantes internacionais de países designados; inscrição pelo portal A2A, seleção pela Embaixada da Índia.
pt.english_test: Conforme requisitos da universidade indiana
pt.notes: Calendário 2026-27: portal A2A aberto de 7 fev a 15 abr 2026. Calendário 2027-28 ainda não divulgado; costuma abrir por volta de fevereiro. Confirme a cota da Indonésia com a Embaixada da Índia em Jacarta.

es.name: ICCR Scholarship (Government of India)
es.fields: Grado, máster y doctorado en universidades indias
es.coverage: Beca del Gobierno de la India (detalle de asignaciones en el portal A2A de ICCR)
es.eligibility: Estudiantes internacionales de países designados; solicitud por el portal A2A, selección por la Embajada de la India.
es.english_test: Según los requisitos de la universidad india
es.notes: Calendario 2026-27: portal A2A abierto del 7 feb al 15 abr 2026. El de 2027-28 no se ha anunciado; suele abrir hacia febrero. Confirma el cupo de Indonesia con la Embajada de la India en Yakarta.

de.name: ICCR Scholarship (Government of India)
de.fields: Bachelor-, Master- und PhD-Programme an indischen Universitäten
de.coverage: Stipendium der indischen Regierung (Leistungen siehe ICCR-A2A-Portal)
de.eligibility: Internationale Studierende aus festgelegten Ländern; Bewerbung über das A2A-Portal, Auswahl durch die indische Botschaft.
de.english_test: Gemäß den Anforderungen der indischen Universität
de.notes: Zeitplan 2026-27: A2A-Portal offen vom 7. Feb. bis 15. Apr. 2026. Zeitplan 2027-28 noch nicht bekannt; Öffnung bisher meist im Februar. Kontingent für Indonesien bei der indischen Botschaft in Jakarta bestätigen.

it.name: ICCR Scholarship (Government of India)
it.fields: Lauree, master e dottorati in università indiane
it.coverage: Borsa del Governo indiano (dettagli delle indennità sul portale A2A dell’ICCR)
it.eligibility: Studenti internazionali di paesi designati; domanda tramite portale A2A, selezione dell’Ambasciata indiana.
it.english_test: Secondo i requisiti dell’università indiana
it.notes: Calendario 2026-27: portale A2A aperto 7 feb - 15 apr 2026. Calendario 2027-28 non ancora annunciato; di solito apre verso febbraio. Verifica la quota per l’Indonesia con l’Ambasciata indiana a Giacarta.

nl.name: ICCR Scholarship (Government of India)
nl.fields: Bachelor-, master- en PhD-opleidingen aan Indiase universiteiten
nl.coverage: Beurs van de Indiase overheid (details toelagen op het ICCR A2A-portaal)
nl.eligibility: Internationale studenten uit aangewezen landen; aanmelden via het A2A-portaal, selectie door de Indiase ambassade.
nl.english_test: Volgens de eisen van de Indiase universiteit
nl.notes: Planning 2026-27: A2A-portaal open 7 feb - 15 apr 2026. Planning 2027-28 nog niet bekend; opent meestal rond februari. Bevestig het quotum voor Indonesië bij de Indiase ambassade in Jakarta.

ru.name: ICCR Scholarship (Government of India)
ru.fields: Бакалавриат, магистратура и PhD в университетах Индии
ru.coverage: Стипендия правительства Индии (подробности выплат на портале A2A ICCR)
ru.eligibility: Иностранные студенты из установленных стран; подача через портал A2A, отбор посольством Индии.
ru.notes: График 2026-27: портал A2A открыт 7 фев. — 15 апр. 2026. График 2027-28 не объявлен; обычно открывается около февраля. Квоту для Индонезии уточняйте в посольстве Индии в Джакарте.

items.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
items.fields: Riset pascasarjana/doktoral semua bidang di universitas negeri Swiss
items.coverage: Tunjangan bulanan CHF 2.450 selama masa beasiswa
items.eligibility: Untuk Indonesia: Research Fellowship & PhD. Peneliti muda yang sudah lulus S2 (paling lambat 31 Jul 2027), lahir setelah 31 Des 1991; wajib rencana riset dan surat dukungan supervisor di kampus Swiss.
items.english_test: Sesuai syarat kampus/supervisor di Swiss
items.notes: Pendaftaran online lewat portal GO ESKAS; batas untuk Indonesia 30 Nov 2026 pukul 23.59 waktu Swiss (daftar negara resmi SERI, Asia, 4 Agu 2026). Cari supervisor sedini mungkin.

en.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
en.fields: Postgraduate/doctoral research in any field at Swiss public universities
en.coverage: Monthly allowance of CHF 2,450 during the scholarship
en.eligibility: For Indonesia: Research Fellowship & PhD. Early-career researchers with a Master's completed by 31 Jul 2027, born after 31 Dec 1991; research plan and a support letter from a supervisor at a Swiss institution required.
en.english_test: As per the Swiss institution/supervisor
en.notes: Apply online via the GO ESKAS portal; deadline for Indonesia 30 Nov 2026, 11:59pm Swiss time (official SERI country list, Asia, 4 Aug 2026). Find a supervisor early.

th.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
th.country: สวิตเซอร์แลนด์
th.fields: วิจัยระดับบัณฑิตศึกษา/ปริญญาเอกทุกสาขาในมหาวิทยาลัยรัฐของสวิตเซอร์แลนด์
th.coverage: เบี้ยเลี้ยงรายเดือน CHF 2,450 ตลอดระยะทุน
th.eligibility: นักวิจัยรุ่นใหม่ที่จบปริญญาโทภายใน 31 ก.ค. 2027 เกิดหลัง 31 ธ.ค. 1991 ต้องมีแผนวิจัยและจดหมายสนับสนุนจากอาจารย์ที่ปรึกษาในสถาบันสวิส
th.english_test: ตามเกณฑ์สถาบัน/อาจารย์ที่ปรึกษาในสวิส
th.intake: กันยายน 2027
th.notes: สมัครออนไลน์ผ่านพอร์ทัล GO ESKAS กำหนดปิดสำหรับอินโดนีเซีย 30 พ.ย. 2026 (ตรวจสอบอีกครั้งในหน้าประเทศของ SERI) ควรหาอาจารย์ที่ปรึกษาแต่เนิ่น ๆ

vi.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
vi.fields: Nghiên cứu sau đại học/tiến sĩ mọi ngành tại đại học công lập Thụy Sĩ
vi.coverage: Trợ cấp hằng tháng CHF 2.450 trong thời gian học bổng
vi.eligibility: Nhà nghiên cứu trẻ đã có bằng thạc sĩ trước 31/7/2027, sinh sau 31/12/1991; cần kế hoạch nghiên cứu và thư hỗ trợ của người hướng dẫn tại trường Thụy Sĩ.
vi.english_test: Theo yêu cầu của trường/người hướng dẫn tại Thụy Sĩ
vi.notes: Nộp trực tuyến qua cổng GO ESKAS; hạn cho Indonesia 30/11/2026 (kiểm tra lại trên trang quốc gia của SERI). Nên tìm người hướng dẫn sớm.

zh.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
zh.fields: 瑞士公立大学任何领域的研究生/博士研究
zh.coverage: 奖学金期间每月 CHF 2,450 津贴
zh.eligibility: 2027-07-31 前获得硕士学位、1991-12-31 之后出生的青年研究者；需提交研究计划及瑞士院校导师支持信。
zh.english_test: 按瑞士院校/导师要求
zh.notes: 通过 GO ESKAS 门户在线申请；印尼截止日期 2026-11-30（请在 SERI 国别页面复核）。尽早联系导师。

ja.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
ja.fields: スイスの公立大学における全分野の大学院・博士研究
ja.coverage: 奨学期間中 月 CHF 2,450 の手当
ja.eligibility: 2027年7月31日までに修士修了、1991年12月31日以降生まれの若手研究者。研究計画書とスイスの指導教員の支援状が必要。
ja.english_test: スイスの機関・指導教員の要件に準拠
ja.notes: GO ESKAS ポータルでオンライン申請。インドネシアの締切は 2026年11月30日（SERI の国別ページで再確認）。指導教員探しは早めに。

ko.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
ko.fields: 스위스 공립대학의 모든 분야 대학원/박사 연구
ko.coverage: 장학 기간 월 CHF 2,450 지원
ko.eligibility: 2027-07-31까지 석사 취득, 1991-12-31 이후 출생 신진 연구자; 연구계획서와 스위스 기관 지도교수 지원서 필요.
ko.notes: GO ESKAS 포털로 온라인 지원; 인도네시아 마감 2026-11-30(SERI 국가별 페이지에서 재확인). 지도교수를 일찍 찾으세요.

km.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
km.fields: ការស្រាវជ្រាវក្រោយបរិញ្ញា/បណ្ឌិតគ្រប់ជំនាញនៅសាកលវិទ្យាល័យរដ្ឋស្វ៊ីស
km.coverage: ប្រាក់ឧបត្ថម្ភប្រចាំខែ CHF 2,450 ក្នុងរយៈពេលអាហារូបករណ៍
km.eligibility: អ្នកស្រាវជ្រាវវ័យក្មេងដែលបញ្ចប់អនុបណ្ឌិតមុន 31 កក្កដា 2027 កើតក្រោយ 31 ធ្នូ 1991; ត្រូវមានផែនការស្រាវជ្រាវ និងលិខិតគាំទ្រពីអ្នកណែនាំនៅស្ថាប័នស្វ៊ីស។
km.english_test: តាមលក្ខខណ្ឌស្ថាប័ន/អ្នកណែនាំនៅស្វ៊ីស
km.notes: ដាក់ពាក្យអនឡាញតាមវិបផតថល GO ESKAS; ផុតកំណត់សម្រាប់ឥណ្ឌូនេស៊ី 30 វិច្ឆិកា 2026 (ពិនិត្យម្តងទៀតនៅទំព័រប្រទេស SERI)។ ស្វែងរកអ្នកណែនាំឱ្យបានឆាប់។

fr.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
fr.fields: Recherche postgrade/doctorale dans tous les domaines dans les hautes écoles publiques suisses
fr.coverage: Allocation mensuelle de CHF 2 450 pendant la bourse
fr.eligibility: Jeunes chercheurs ayant un master obtenu au plus tard le 31 juil. 2027, nés après le 31 déc. 1991 ; plan de recherche et lettre de soutien d’un superviseur en Suisse requis.
fr.english_test: Selon l’établissement/le superviseur suisse
fr.notes: Candidature en ligne via le portail GO ESKAS ; date limite pour l’Indonésie 30 nov. 2026 (à revérifier sur la page pays du SEFRI). Trouvez un superviseur tôt.

pt.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
pt.fields: Pesquisa de pós-graduação/doutorado em qualquer área em universidades públicas suíças
pt.coverage: Auxílio mensal de CHF 2.450 durante a bolsa
pt.eligibility: Pesquisadores em início de carreira com mestrado concluído até 31 jul 2027, nascidos após 31 dez 1991; plano de pesquisa e carta de apoio de orientador em instituição suíça.
pt.english_test: Conforme a instituição/orientador na Suíça
pt.notes: Inscrição online pelo portal GO ESKAS; prazo para a Indonésia 30 nov 2026 (confira na página do país na SERI). Procure um orientador cedo.

es.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
es.fields: Investigación de posgrado/doctorado en cualquier área en universidades públicas suizas
es.coverage: Asignación mensual de CHF 2.450 durante la beca
es.eligibility: Investigadores noveles con máster terminado antes del 31 jul 2027, nacidos después del 31 dic 1991; plan de investigación y carta de apoyo de un supervisor en una institución suiza.
es.english_test: Según la institución/el supervisor en Suiza
es.notes: Solicitud en línea por el portal GO ESKAS; plazo para Indonesia 30 nov 2026 (revisa la página del país en SERI). Busca supervisor con antelación.

de.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
de.fields: Postgraduale/Doktorats-Forschung in allen Fächern an öffentlichen Schweizer Hochschulen
de.coverage: Monatliches Stipendium von CHF 2.450
de.eligibility: Nachwuchsforschende mit Masterabschluss bis 31. Juli 2027, geboren nach dem 31. Dez. 1991; Forschungsplan und Unterstützungsschreiben einer Betreuungsperson an einer Schweizer Hochschule erforderlich.
de.english_test: Gemäß Schweizer Hochschule/Betreuungsperson
de.notes: Online-Bewerbung über das Portal GO ESKAS; Frist für Indonesien 30. Nov. 2026 (auf der SBFI-Länderseite nachprüfen). Früh eine Betreuungsperson suchen.

it.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
it.fields: Ricerca post-laurea/dottorale in ogni ambito presso università pubbliche svizzere
it.coverage: Indennità mensile di CHF 2.450 per la durata della borsa
it.eligibility: Giovani ricercatori con master conseguito entro il 31 lug 2027, nati dopo il 31 dic 1991; piano di ricerca e lettera di supporto di un supervisore in un istituto svizzero.
it.english_test: Secondo l’istituto/il supervisore in Svizzera
it.notes: Candidatura online tramite il portale GO ESKAS; scadenza per l’Indonesia 30 nov 2026 (ricontrolla sulla pagina paese della SEFRI). Cerca presto un supervisore.

nl.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
nl.fields: Postgraduaat/promotieonderzoek in elk vakgebied aan Zwitserse publieke universiteiten
nl.coverage: Maandelijkse toelage van CHF 2.450 tijdens de beurs
nl.eligibility: Beginnende onderzoekers met een master behaald uiterlijk 31 jul 2027, geboren na 31 dec 1991; onderzoeksplan en steunbrief van een begeleider aan een Zwitserse instelling vereist.
nl.english_test: Volgens de Zwitserse instelling/begeleider
nl.notes: Online aanmelden via het GO ESKAS-portaal; deadline voor Indonesië 30 nov 2026 (controleer op de landenpagina van SERI). Zoek tijdig een begeleider.

ru.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027-2028 (Research)
ru.fields: Исследования в аспирантуре/докторантуре по любой специальности в государственных вузах Швейцарии
ru.coverage: Ежемесячная выплата CHF 2 450 на срок стипендии
ru.eligibility: Молодые исследователи с магистратурой, завершённой до 31 июля 2027, рождённые после 31 дек. 1991; нужны план исследования и письмо поддержки научного руководителя в швейцарском вузе.
ru.notes: Подача онлайн через портал GO ESKAS; срок для Индонезии — 30 нояб. 2026 (перепроверьте на странице страны SERI). Ищите руководителя заранее.

items.name: Murdoch University Dubai Academic Merit Scholarships
items.fields: Foundation, Diploma, S1, S2 & MBA di Murdoch University Dubai
items.coverage: Potongan tuition 15%/25%/35%/40% sesuai nilai sebelumnya (Foundation 50%, Diploma 25%, MBA 20%); bisa digabung Early Bird 5%
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa baru (termasuk internasional) berdasarkan nilai akademik sebelumnya; mulai kuliah di trimester. Dinilai ulang tiap trimester (semua unit harus lulus).
items.english_test: Sesuai syarat masuk Murdoch University Dubai
items.notes: Tidak perlu aplikasi terpisah: dinilai otomatis dari nilai saat mendaftar. Hanya potongan tuition (tidak termasuk biaya hidup, akomodasi, visa). Daftar lewat konsultan Talented.

en.name: Murdoch University Dubai Academic Merit Scholarships
en.fields: Foundation, Diploma, Bachelor's, Master's and MBA at Murdoch University Dubai
en.coverage: Tuition reduction of 15%/25%/35%/40% based on prior results (Foundation 50%, Diploma 25%, MBA 20%); combinable with the 5% Early Bird
en.eligibility: New students (international included) based on previous academic results; start in a trimester. Reviewed every trimester (all units must be passed).
en.english_test: As per Murdoch University Dubai entry requirements
en.notes: No separate application: assessed automatically from your results when you apply. Tuition reduction only (no living costs, accommodation or visa). Apply through your Talented consultant.

th.name: Murdoch University Dubai Academic Merit Scholarships
th.country: สหรัฐอาหรับเอมิเรตส์
th.fields: Foundation, Diploma, ปริญญาตรี, ปริญญาโท และ MBA ที่ Murdoch University Dubai
th.coverage: ลดค่าเล่าเรียน 15%/25%/35%/40% ตามผลการเรียนเดิม (Foundation 50%, Diploma 25%, MBA 20%) ใช้ร่วมกับ Early Bird 5% ได้
th.amount: 15% - 40% ของค่าเล่าเรียน
th.eligibility: นักศึกษาใหม่ (รวมต่างชาติ) พิจารณาจากผลการเรียนเดิม เริ่มเรียนในภาคเรียนไตรภาค ทบทวนทุกภาค (ต้องผ่านทุกวิชา)
th.english_test: ตามเกณฑ์รับเข้า Murdoch University Dubai
th.intake: ทุกภาคเรียน (ไตรภาค)
th.notes: ไม่ต้องสมัครแยก พิจารณาอัตโนมัติจากผลการเรียนตอนสมัคร ลดเฉพาะค่าเล่าเรียน (ไม่รวมค่าครองชีพ ที่พัก วีซ่า) สมัครผ่านที่ปรึกษา Talented

vi.name: Murdoch University Dubai Academic Merit Scholarships
vi.country: Các Tiểu vương quốc Ả Rập Thống nhất
vi.fields: Foundation, Diploma, cử nhân, thạc sĩ và MBA tại Murdoch University Dubai
vi.coverage: Giảm học phí 15%/25%/35%/40% theo kết quả học tập trước (Foundation 50%, Diploma 25%, MBA 20%); kết hợp được với Early Bird 5%
vi.eligibility: Sinh viên mới (gồm quốc tế) dựa trên kết quả học tập trước; nhập học theo tam cá nguyệt. Xét lại mỗi kỳ (phải qua tất cả môn).

zh.name: Murdoch University Dubai Academic Merit Scholarships

ko.name: Murdoch University Dubai Academic Merit Scholarships

ko.eligibility: 신입생(유학생 포함), 이전 학업 성적 기준; 트라이메스터 입학. 매 학기 재심사(전 과목 이수 필요).

km.name: Murdoch University Dubai Academic Merit Scholarships

km.english_test: តាមលក្ខខណ្ឌចូលរៀន Murdoch University Dubai
km.intake: រៀងរាល់ត្រីមាស
km.notes: មិនចាំបាច់ដាក់ពាក្យដាច់ដោយឡែក៖ វាយតម្លៃដោយស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ។ បញ្ចុះតែថ្លៃសិក្សា (មិនរាប់ថ្លៃរស់នៅ ស្នាក់នៅ ទិដ្ឋាការ)។ ដាក់ពាក្យតាមទីប្រឹក្សា Talented។

fr.name: Murdoch University Dubai Academic Merit Scholarships

pt.name: Murdoch University Dubai Academic Merit Scholarships

es.eligibility: Nuevos estudiantes (incluidos internacionales) según notas previas; inicio por trimestre. Revisión cada trimestre (aprobar todas las asignaturas).

it.eligibility: Nuovi studenti (anche internazionali) in base ai voti precedenti; inizio per trimestre. Rivalutata ogni trimestre (superare tutti gli esami).

fr.name: RIC International School Network Scholarship (RISNS) - Rangsit University
